verses.english: The word of YHWH that came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.hebrew: דְּבַר־יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר הָיָה אֶל־הוֹשֵׁעַ בֶּן־בְּאֵרִי בִּימֵי עֻזִּיָּה יוֹתָם אָחָז יְחִזְקִיָּה מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָה וּבִימֵי יָרָבְעָם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: The beginning of YHWH's speaking through Hosea. YHWH said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of prostitution, for the land commits great prostitution by turning away from YHWH.”
verses.hebrew: תְּחִלַּת דִּבֶּר־יְהוָה בְּהוֹשֵׁעַ וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֶל־הוֹשֵׁעַ לֵךְ קַח־לְךָ אֵשֶׁת זְנוּנִים וְיַלְדֵי זְנוּנִים כִּי־זָנֹה תִזְנֶה הָאָרֶץ מֵאַחֲרֵי יְהוָה׃

verses.english: He went and took Gomer daughter of Diblaim; she conceived and bore him a son.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלֶךְ וַיִּקַּח אֶת־גֹּמֶר בַּת־דִּבְלָיִם וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד־לוֹ בֵּן׃

verses.english: YHWH said to him, “Name him Jezreel, for in a little while I will call Jehu's house to account for the bloodshed of Jezreel and put an end to the kingdom of Israel's house.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלָיו קְרָא שְׁמוֹ יִזְרְעֶאל כִּי־עוֹד מְעַט וּפָקַדְתִּי אֶת־דְּמֵי יִזְרְעֶאל עַל־בֵּית יֵהוּא וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי מַמְלְכוּת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: On that day I will break Israel's bow in the Valley of Jezreel.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא וְשָׁבַרְתִּי אֶת־קֶשֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֵמֶק יִזְרְעֶאל׃

verses.english: She conceived again and bore a daughter. He said to him, “Name her Lo-ruhamah—Not Pitied—for I will no longer have compassion on Israel's house, that I should ever forgive them.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בַּת וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ קְרָא שְׁמָהּ לֹא רֻחָמָה כִּי לֹא אוֹסִיף עוֹד אֲרַחֵם אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־נָשֹׂא אֶשָּׂא לָהֶם׃

verses.english: But I will have compassion on Judah's house and save them by YHWH their God. I will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses or horsemen.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בֵּית יְהוּדָה אֲרַחֵם וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּים בַּיהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא אוֹשִׁיעֵם בְּקֶשֶׁת וּבְחֶרֶב וּבְמִלְחָמָה בְּסוּסִים וּבְפָרָשִׁים׃

verses.english: She weaned Lo-ruhamah, conceived and bore a son.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּגְמֹל אֶת־לֹא רֻחָמָה וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן׃

verses.english: He said, “Name him Lo-ammi—Not My People—for you are not My people, and I will not be yours.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר קְרָא שְׁמוֹ לֹא עַמִּי כִּי אַתֶּם לֹא עַמִּי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא־אֶהְיֶה לָכֶם׃

verses.english: The number of Israel's sons will be like the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ it will be said to them, ‘Sons of the living God.’
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה מִסְפַּר בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּחוֹל הַיָּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִמַּד וְלֹא יִסָּפֵר וְהָיָה בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֵאָמֵר לָהֶם לֹא־עַמִּי אַתֶּם יֵאָמֵר לָהֶם בְּנֵי אֵל־חָי׃

verses.english: Judah's sons and Israel's sons will be gathered together, appoint one head for themselves and come up from the land, for great is Jezreel's day.
verses.hebrew: וְנִקְבְּצוּ בְּנֵי־יְהוּדָה וּבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל יַחְדָּו וְשָׂמוּ לָהֶם רֹאשׁ אֶחָד וְעָלוּ מִן־הָאָרֶץ כִּי גָדוֹל יוֹם יִזְרְעֶאל׃

verses.english: Say to your brothers, ‘Ammi—My People,’ and to your sisters, ‘Ruhamah—Pitied.’
verses.hebrew: אִמְרוּ לַאֲחֵיכֶם עַמִּי וְלַאֲחוֹתֵיכֶם רֻחָמָה׃

verses.english: “Contend with your mother, contend! For she is not My wife and I am not her husband. Let her remove her prostitution from her face and her adulteries from between her breasts,
verses.hebrew: רִיבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם רִיבוּ כִּי־הִיא לֹא אִשְׁתִּי וְאָנֹכִי לֹא אִישָׁהּ וְתָסֵר זְנוּנֶיהָ מִפָּנֶיה וְנַאֲפוּפֶיהָ מִבֵּין שָׁדֶיהָ׃

verses.english: lest I strip her naked and set her as on the day of her birth, make her like a wilderness, place her like a dry land and kill her with thirst.
verses.hebrew: פֶּן־אַפְשִׁיטֶנָּה עֲרֻמָּה וְהִצַּגְתִּיהָ כְּיוֹם הִוָּלְדָהּ וְשַׂמְתִּיהָ כַמִּדְבָּר וְשַׁתִּהָ כְּאֶרֶץ צִיָּה וַהֲמִתִּיהָ בַּצָּמָא׃

verses.english: I will have no compassion on her children, for they are children of prostitution.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בָּנֶיהָ לֹא אֲרַחֵם כִּי־בְנֵי זְנוּנִים הֵמָּה׃

verses.english: For their mother prostituted herself; she who conceived them acted shamefully. She said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and water, my wool and flax, my oil and drinks.’
verses.hebrew: כִּי זָנְתָה אִמָּם הֹבִישָׁה הוֹרָתָם כִּי אָמְרָה אֵלְכָה אַחֲרֵי מְאַהֲבַי נֹתְנֵי לַחְמִי וּמֵימַי צַמְרִי וּפִשְׁתִּי שַׁמְנִי וְשִׁקּוּיָי׃

verses.english: Therefore look, I will hedge your way with thorns; I will wall up her enclosure, and she will not find her paths.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנְנִי־שָׂךְ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּךְ בַּסִּירִים וְגָדַרְתִּי אֶת־גְּדֵרָהּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶיהָ לֹא תִמְצָא׃

verses.english: She will pursue her lovers but not overtake them; seek them but not find them. She will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband, for it was better for me then than now.’
verses.hebrew: וְרִדְּפָה אֶת־מְאַהֲבֶיהָ וְלֹא־תַשִּׂיג אֹתָם וּבִקְשָׁתַם וְלֹא תִמְצָא וְאָמְרָה אֵלְכָה וְאָשׁוּבָה אֶל־אִישִׁי הָרִאשׁוֹן כִּי טוֹב לִי אָז מֵעָתָּה׃

verses.english: She did not know that it was I who gave her grain, new wine and fresh oil, who multiplied silver for her—and gold they used for Baal.
verses.hebrew: וְהִיא לֹא יָדְעָה כִּי אָנֹכִי נָתַתִּי לָהּ הַדָּגָן וְהַתִּירוֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָר וְכֶסֶף הִרְבֵּיתִי לָהּ וְזָהָב עָשׂוּ לַבָּעַל׃

verses.english: Therefore I will return and take My grain in its season and My new wine at its appointed time; I will snatch away My wool and flax that were to cover her nakedness.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן אָשׁוּב וְלָקַחְתִּי דְגָנִי בְּעִתּוֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי צַמְרִי וּפִשְׁתִּי לְכַסּוֹת אֶת־עֶרְוָתָהּ׃

verses.english: Now I will uncover her disgrace before her lovers' eyes, and no one will rescue her from My hand.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲגַלֶּה אֶת־נַבְלֻתָהּ לְעֵינֵי מְאַהֲבֶיהָ וְאִישׁ לֹא־יַצִּילֶנָּה מִיָּדִי׃

verses.english: I will end all her joy, her festival, new moon and Sabbath, and every appointed feast.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי כָּל־מְשׂוֹשָׂהּ חַגָּהּ חָדְשָׁהּ וְשַׁבַּתָּהּ וְכֹל מוֹעֲדָהּ׃

verses.english: I will lay waste her vine and fig tree, of which she said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers gave me.’ I will make them a forest, and wild animals will devour them.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִי גַּפְנָהּ וּתְאֵנָתָהּ אֲשֶׁר אָמְרָה אֶתְנָה הֵמָּה לִי אֲשֶׁר נָתְנוּ־לִי מְאַהֲבָי וְשַׂמְתִּים לְיַעַר וַאֲכָלָתַם חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה׃

verses.english: I will call her to account for the days of the Baals, when she burned offerings to them, adorned herself with her ring and jewelry and went after her lovers, but forgot Me,” declares YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וּפָקַדְתִּי עָלֶיהָ אֶת־יְמֵי הַבְּעָלִים אֲשֶׁר תַּקְטִיר לָהֶם וַתַּעַד נִזְמָהּ וְחֶלְיָתָהּ וַתֵּלֶךְ אַחֲרֵי מְאַהֲבֶיהָ וְאֹתִי שָׁכְחָה נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: “Therefore look, I will allure her, lead her into the wilderness and speak to her heart.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן הִנֵּה אָנֹכִי מְפַתֶּיהָ וְהֹלַכְתִּיהָ הַמִּדְבָּר וְדִבַּרְתִּי עַל לִבָּהּ׃

verses.english: From there I will give her her vineyards and the Valley of Achor as a door of hope. There she will answer as in the days of her youth, as on the day she came up from Egypt's land.
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַתִּי לָהּ אֶת־כְּרָמֶיהָ מִשָּׁם וְאֶת־עֵמֶק עָכוֹר לְפֶתַח תִּקְוָה וְעָנְתָה שָּׁמָּה כִּימֵי נְעוּרֶיהָ וִּכְיוֹם עֲלֹתָהּ מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: On that day,” declares YHWH, “you will call Me ‘My Husband’ and no longer call Me ‘My Baal.’
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא נְאֻם־יְהוָה תִּקְרְאִי אִישִׁי וְלֹא־תִקְרְאִי־לִי עוֹד בַּעְלִי׃

verses.english: I will remove the names of the Baals from her mouth, and they will no longer be remembered by their names.
verses.hebrew: וַהֲסִרֹתִי אֶת־שְׁמוֹת הַבְּעָלִים מִפִּיהָ וְלֹא־יִזָּכְרוּ עוֹד בִּשְׁמָם׃

verses.english: On that day I will make a covenant for them with the field's beasts, heaven's birds and the ground's creeping things. I will break bow, sword and war from the land and make them lie down securely.
verses.hebrew: וְכָרַתִּי לָהֶם בְּרִית בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עִם־חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וְעִם־עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם וְרֶמֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָה וְקֶשֶׁת וְחֶרֶב וּמִלְחָמָה אֶשְׁבּוֹר מִן־הָאָרֶץ וְהִשְׁכַּבְתִּים לָבֶטַח׃

verses.english: I will betroth you to Myself forever; I will betroth you to Myself in righteousness and justice, in steadfast love and compassion.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי לְעוֹלָם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי בְּצֶדֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּט וּבְחֶסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים׃

verses.english: I will betroth you to Myself in faithfulness, and you will know YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּיךְ לִי בֶּאֱמוּנָה וְיָדַעַתְּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: On that day I will answer,” declares YHWH, “I will answer the heavens, and they will answer the earth.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אֶעֱנֶה נְאֻם־יְהוָה אֶעֱנֶה אֶת־הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהֵם יַעֲנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: The earth will answer the grain, new wine and fresh oil, and they will answer Jezreel.
verses.hebrew: וְהָאָרֶץ תַּעֲנֶה אֶת־הַדָּגָן וְאֶת־הַתִּירוֹשׁ וְאֶת־הַיִּצְהָר וְהֵם יַעֲנוּ אֶת־יִזְרְעֶאל׃

verses.english: I will sow her for Myself in the land, have compassion on Lo-ruhamah—Not Pitied—and say to Lo-ammi—Not My People—‘You are My people.’ He will say, ‘My God!’”
verses.hebrew: וּזְרַעְתִּיהָ לִּי בָּאָרֶץ וְרִחַמְתִּי אֶת־לֹא רֻחָמָה וְאָמַרְתִּי לְלֹא־עַמִּי עַמִּי־אַתָּה וְהוּא יֹאמַר אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: YHWH said to me again, “Go, love a woman loved by a companion and committing adultery, as YHWH loves Israel's sons, though they turn to other gods and love raisin cakes.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוָה אֵלַי עוֹד לֵךְ אֱ‍הַב־אִשָּׁה אֲהֻבַת רֵעַ וּמְנָאָפֶת כְּאַהֲבַת יְהוָה אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהֵם פֹּנִים אֶל־אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים וְאֹהֲבֵי אֲשִׁישֵׁי עֲנָבִים׃

verses.english: I acquired her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver, a homer of barley and a lethech of barley.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶכְּרֶהָ לִּי בַּחֲמִשָּׁה עָשָׂר כָּסֶף וְחֹמֶר שְׂעֹרִים וְלֵתֶךְ שְׂעֹרִים׃

verses.english: I said to her, “You will remain for me many days; you must not prostitute yourself or belong to a man, and I likewise toward you.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אֵלֶיהָ יָמִים רַבִּים תֵּשְׁבִי לִי לֹא תִזְנִי וְלֹא תִהְיִי לְאִישׁ וְגַם־אֲנִי אֵלָיִךְ׃

verses.english: For Israel's sons will remain many days without king or official, without sacrifice or standing stone, without ephod or teraphim.
verses.hebrew: כִּי יָמִים רַבִּים יֵשְׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵין מֶלֶךְ וְאֵין שָׂר וְאֵין זֶבַח וְאֵין מַצֵּבָה וְאֵין אֵפוֹד וּתְרָפִים׃

verses.english: Afterward Israel's sons will return and seek YHWH their God and David their king; they will come trembling to YHWH and His goodness in the latter days.
verses.hebrew: אַחַר יָשֻׁבוּ בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִקְשׁוּ אֶת־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְאֵת דָּוִד מַלְכָּם וּפָחֲדוּ אֶל־יְהוָה וְאֶל־טוּבוֹ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים׃

verses.english: Hear YHWH's word, sons of Israel, for YHWH has a dispute with the land's inhabitants: there is no faithfulness, no steadfast love and no knowledge of God in the land.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ דְבַר־יְהוָה בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי רִיב לַיהוָה עִם־יוֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ כִּי אֵין־אֱמֶת וְאֵין־חֶסֶד וְאֵין־דַּעַת אֱלֹהִים בָּאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Cursing and lying, murder and stealing and adultery break out; bloodshed touches bloodshed.
verses.hebrew: אָלֹה וְכַחֵשׁ וְרָצֹחַ וְגָנֹב וְנָאֹף פָּרָצוּ וְדָמִים בְּדָמִים נָגָעוּ׃

verses.english: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone dwelling in it will languish, together with the field's beasts and heaven's birds; even the sea's fish will be swept away.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן תֶּאֱבַל הָאָרֶץ וְאֻמְלַל כָּל־יוֹשֵׁב בָּהּ בְּחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה וּבְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם וְגַם־דְּגֵי הַיָּם יֵאָסֵפוּ׃

verses.english: Yet let no one contend and no one rebuke, for your people are like those contending with a priest.
verses.hebrew: אַךְ אִישׁ אַל־יָרֵב וְאַל־יוֹכַח אִישׁ וְעַמְּךָ כִּמְרִיבֵי כֹהֵן׃

verses.english: You will stumble by day; a prophet will also stumble with you by night, and I will destroy your mother.
verses.hebrew: וְכָשַׁלְתָּ הַיּוֹם וְכָשַׁל גַּם־נָבִיא עִמְּךָ לָיְלָה וְדָמִיתִי אִמֶּךָ׃

verses.english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you rejected knowledge, I reject you from serving Me as priest. Since you forgot your God's instruction, I too will forget your sons.
verses.hebrew: נִדְמוּ עַמִּי מִבְּלִי הַדָּעַת כִּי־אַתָּה הַדַּעַת מָאַסְתָּ וְאֶמְאָסְאךָ מִכַּהֵן לִי וַתִּשְׁכַּח תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהֶיךָ אֶשְׁכַּח בָּנֶיךָ גַּם־אָנִי׃

verses.english: As they increased, so they sinned against Me; I will exchange their glory for disgrace.
verses.hebrew: כְּרֻבָּם כֵּן חָטְאוּ־לִי כְּבוֹדָם בְּקָלוֹן אָמִיר׃

verses.english: They eat My people's sin offering and lift their appetite toward their guilt.
verses.hebrew: חַטַּאת עַמִּי יֹאכֵלוּ וְאֶל־עֲוֺנָם יִשְׂאוּ נַפְשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; I will call him to account for his ways and repay him for his deeds.
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כָעָם כַּכֹּהֵן וּפָקַדְתִּי עָלָיו דְּרָכָיו וּמַעֲלָלָיו אָשִׁיב לוֹ׃

verses.english: They will eat but not be satisfied; they will prostitute themselves but not increase, because they abandoned keeping faith with YHWH.
verses.hebrew: וְאָכְלוּ וְלֹא יִשְׂבָּעוּ הִזְנוּ וְלֹא יִפְרֹצוּ כִּי־אֶת־יְהוָה עָזְבוּ לִשְׁמֹר׃

verses.english: Prostitution, wine and new wine take away understanding.
verses.hebrew: זְנוּת וְיַיִן וְתִירוֹשׁ יִקַּח־לֵב׃

verses.english: My people consult their wood, and their staff tells them things; for a spirit of prostitution led them astray, and they prostituted themselves away from their God.
verses.hebrew: עַמִּי בְּעֵצוֹ יִשְׁאָל וּמַקְלוֹ יַגִּיד לוֹ כִּי רוּחַ זְנוּנִים הִתְעָה וַיִּזְנוּ מִתַּחַת אֱלֹהֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: On the mountaintops they sacrifice, and on the hills they burn offerings, under oak, poplar and terebinth, because their shade is good. Therefore your daughters prostitute themselves and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
verses.hebrew: עַל־רָאשֵׁי הֶהָרִים יְזַבֵּחוּ וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת יְקַטֵּרוּ תַּחַת אַלּוֹן וְלִבְנֶה וְאֵלָה כִּי טוֹב צִלָּהּ עַל־כֵּן תִּזְנֶינָה בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם וְכַלּוֹתֵיכֶם תְּנָאַפְנָה׃

verses.english: I will not call your daughters to account when they prostitute themselves, or your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, for the men themselves go apart with prostitutes and sacrifice with consecrated women. A people without understanding comes to ruin.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־אֶפְקוֹד עַל־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶם כִּי תִזְנֶינָה וְעַל־כַּלּוֹתֵיכֶם כִּי תְנָאַפְנָה כִּי־הֵם עִם־הַזֹּנוֹת יְפָרֵדוּ וְעִם־הַקְּדֵשׁוֹת יְזַבֵּחוּ וְעָם לֹא־יָבִין יִלָּבֵט׃

verses.english: Though you prostitute yourself, Israel, let Judah not become guilty. Do not enter Gilgal or go up to Beth-aven, and do not swear, ‘As YHWH lives!’
verses.hebrew: אִם־זֹנֶה אַתָּה יִשְׂרָאֵל אַל־יֶאְשַׁם יְהוּדָה וְאַל־תָּבֹאוּ הַגִּלְגָּל וְאַל־תַּעֲלוּ בֵּית אָוֶן וְאַל־תִּשָּׁבְעוּ חַי־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For Israel has been stubborn like a stubborn heifer. Now will YHWH pasture them like a lamb in an open place?
verses.hebrew: כִּי כְּפָרָה סֹרֵרָה סָרַר יִשְׂרָאֵל עַתָּה יִרְעֵם יְהוָה כְּכֶבֶשׂ בַּמֶּרְחָב׃

verses.english: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone.
verses.hebrew: חֲבוּר עֲצַבִּים אֶפְרָיִם הַנַּח־לוֹ׃

verses.english: Their drinking has turned sour; they prostitute themselves continually. Her shields love ‘Give!’—disgrace.
verses.hebrew: סָר סָבְאָם הַזְנֵה הִזְנוּ אָהֲבוּ הֵבוּ קָלוֹן מָגִנֶּיהָ׃

verses.english: A wind has wrapped her in its wings, and they will be ashamed of their sacrifices.
verses.hebrew: צָרַר רוּחַ אוֹתָהּ בִּכְנָפֶיהָ וְיֵבֹשׁוּ מִזִּבְחוֹתָם

verses.english: Hear this, priests; pay attention, house of Israel; listen, house of the king, for the judgment concerns you. You became a trap at Mizpah and a net spread over Tabor.
verses.hebrew: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹאת הַכֹּהֲנִים וְהַקְשִׁיבוּ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבֵית הַמֶּלֶךְ הַאֲזִינוּ כִּי לָכֶם הַמִּשְׁפָּט כִּי־פַח הֱיִיתֶם לְמִצְפָּה וְרֶשֶׁת פְּרוּשָׂה עַל־תָּבוֹר׃

verses.english: The deviators have gone deep into slaughter, but I am discipline for them all.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׁחֲטָה שֵׂטִים הֶעְמִיקוּ וַאֲנִי מוּסָר לְכֻלָּם׃

verses.english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from Me. For now you have prostituted yourself, Ephraim; Israel is defiled.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי אֶפְרַיִם וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־נִכְחַד מִמֶּנִּי כִּי עַתָּה הִזְנֵיתָ אֶפְרַיִם נִטְמָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Their deeds do not permit them to return to their God, for a spirit of prostitution is within them, and they do not know YHWH.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יִתְּנוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם לָשׁוּב אֶל־אֱלֹהֵיהֶם כִּי רוּחַ זְנוּנִים בְּקִרְבָּם וְאֶת־יְהוָה לֹא יָדָעוּ׃

verses.english: Israel's pride testifies against him. Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their guilt; Judah too has stumbled with them.
verses.hebrew: וְעָנָה גְאוֹן־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָנָיו וְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֶפְרַיִם יִכָּשְׁלוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם כָּשַׁל גַּם־יְהוּדָה עִמָּם׃

verses.english: With their flocks and herds they will go to seek YHWH, but they will not find Him; He has withdrawn from them.
verses.hebrew: בְּצֹאנָם וּבִבְקָרָם יֵלְכוּ לְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת־יְהוָה וְלֹא יִמְצָאוּ חָלַץ מֵהֶם׃

verses.english: They dealt treacherously with YHWH, for they fathered foreign sons. Now a new moon will devour them with their portions.
verses.hebrew: בַּיהוָה בָּגָדוּ כִּי־בָנִים זָרִים יָלָדוּ עַתָּה יֹאכְלֵם חֹדֶשׁ אֶת־חֶלְקֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: Blow a horn in Gibeah, a trumpet in Ramah! Sound the alarm at Beth-aven! Behind you, Benjamin!
verses.hebrew: תִּקְעוּ שׁוֹפָר בַּגִּבְעָה חֲצֹצְרָה בָּרָמָה הָרִיעוּ בֵּית אָוֶן אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּנְיָמִין׃

verses.english: Ephraim will become a desolation on the day of correction. Among Israel's tribes I have made known what is certain.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְרַיִם לְשַׁמָּה תִהְיֶה בְּיוֹם תּוֹכֵחָה בְּשִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הוֹדַעְתִּי נֶאֱמָנָה׃

verses.english: Judah's officials have become like people moving a boundary; upon them I will pour My fury like water.
verses.hebrew: הָיוּ שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה כְּמַסִּיגֵי גְּבוּל עֲלֵיהֶם אֶשְׁפּוֹךְ כַּמַּיִם עֶבְרָתִי׃

verses.english: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because he willingly followed a command.
verses.hebrew: עָשׁוּק אֶפְרַיִם רְצוּץ מִשְׁפָּט כִּי הוֹאִיל הָלַךְ אַחֲרֵי־צָו׃

verses.english: I am like a moth to Ephraim and like rot to Judah's house.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כָעָשׁ לְאֶפְרָיִם וְכָרָקָב לְבֵית יְהוּדָה׃

verses.english: Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound; Ephraim went to Assyria and sent to King Jareb. But he cannot heal you or remove the wound from you.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֶפְרַיִם אֶת־חָלְיוֹ וִיהוּדָה אֶת־מְזֹרוֹ וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶפְרַיִם אֶל־אַשּׁוּר וַיִּשְׁלַח אֶל־מֶלֶךְ יָרֵב וְהוּא לֹא יוּכַל לִרְפֹּא לָכֶם וְלֹא־יִגְהֶה מִכֶּם מָזוֹר׃

verses.english: For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to Judah's house. I, I will tear and go away; I will carry off, and no one rescues.
verses.hebrew: כִּי אָנֹכִי כַשַּׁחַל לְאֶפְרַיִם וְכַכְּפִיר לְבֵית יְהוּדָה אֲנִי אֲנִי אֶטְרֹף וְאֵלֵךְ אֶשָּׂא וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃

verses.english: I will go, return to My place, until they acknowledge guilt and seek My face. In their distress they will earnestly seek Me.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֵךְ אָשׁוּבָה אֶל־מְקוֹמִי עַד אֲשֶׁר־יֶאְשְׁמוּ וּבִקְשׁוּ פָנָי בַּצַּר לָהֶם יְשַׁחֲרֻנְנִי׃

verses.english: “Come, let us return to YHWH, for He tore us and will heal us; He strikes and will bind us up.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וְנָשׁוּבָה אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי הוּא טָרָף וְיִרְפָּאֵנוּ יַךְ וְיַחְבְּשֵׁנוּ׃

verses.english: He will revive us after two days; on the third day He will raise us up, and we will live before Him.
verses.hebrew: יְחַיֵּנוּ מִיֹּמָיִם בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יְקִמֵנוּ וְנִחְיֶה לְפָנָיו׃

verses.english: Let us know; let us pursue knowing YHWH. His going forth is established like dawn; He will come to us like rain, like spring rain watering the land.”
verses.hebrew: וְנֵדְעָה נִרְדְּפָה לָדַעַת אֶת־יְהוָה כְּשַׁחַר נָכוֹן מוֹצָאוֹ וְיָבוֹא כַגֶּשֶׁם לָנוּ כְּמַלְקוֹשׁ יוֹרֶה אָרֶץ׃

verses.english: “What shall I do with you, Ephraim? What shall I do with you, Judah? Your steadfast love is like a morning cloud, like dew that goes away early.
verses.hebrew: מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לְּךָ אֶפְרַיִם מָה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לְּךָ יְהוּדָה וְחַסְדְּכֶם כַּעֲנַן־בֹּקֶר וְכַטַּל מַשְׁכִּים הֹלֵךְ׃

verses.english: Therefore I hewed through the prophets; I killed them with the sayings of My mouth, and your judgments go forth as light.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן חָצַבְתִּי בַּנְּבִיאִים הֲרַגְתִּים בְּאִמְרֵי־פִי וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ אוֹר יֵצֵא׃

verses.english: For I desire steadfast love and not sacrifice, knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
verses.hebrew: כִּי חֶסֶד חָפַצְתִּי וְלֹא־זָבַח וְדַעַת אֱלֹהִים מֵעֹלוֹת׃

verses.english: But they, like Adam, transgressed a covenant; there they dealt treacherously with Me.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה כְּאָדָם עָבְרוּ בְרִית שָׁם בָּגְדוּ בִי׃

verses.english: Gilead is a city of evildoers, tracked with blood.
verses.hebrew: גִּלְעָד קִרְיַת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן עֲקֻבָּה מִדָּם׃

verses.english: As raiding bands lie in wait for a man, a company of priests murders on the road toward Shechem; indeed, they commit wickedness.
verses.hebrew: וּכְחַכֵּי אִישׁ גְּדוּדִים חֶבֶר כֹּהֲנִים דֶּרֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ־שֶׁכְמָה כִּי זִמָּה עָשׂוּ׃

verses.english: In Israel's house I have seen a horrifying thing; there is Ephraim's prostitution; Israel is defiled.
verses.hebrew: בְּבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאִיתִי שעריריה [שַׁעֲרוּרִיָּה] שָׁם זְנוּת לְאֶפְרַיִם נִטְמָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: For you too, Judah, a harvest is appointed, when I restore My people's fortunes.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוּדָה שָׁת קָצִיר לָךְ בְּשׁוּבִי שְׁבוּת עַמִּי׃

verses.english: When I heal Israel, Ephraim's guilt and Samaria's evils are exposed, for they practice falsehood. A thief enters; a raiding band strips people outside.
verses.hebrew: כְּרָפְאִי לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִגְלָה עֲוֺן אֶפְרַיִם וְרָעוֹת שֹׁמְרוֹן כִּי פָעֲלוּ שָׁקֶר וְגַנָּב יָבוֹא פָּשַׁט גְּדוּד בַּחוּץ׃

verses.english: They do not say in their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds surround them; they are before My face.
verses.hebrew: וּבַל־יֹאמְרוּ לִלְבָבָם כָּל־רָעָתָם זָכָרְתִּי עַתָּה סְבָבוּם מַעַלְלֵיהֶם נֶגֶד פָּנַי הָיוּ׃

verses.english: With their evil they gladden a king, and with their lies, officials.
verses.hebrew: בְּרָעָתָם יְשַׂמְּחוּ־מֶלֶךְ וּבְכַחֲשֵׁיהֶם שָׂרִים׃

verses.english: All of them are adulterers, like an oven heated by a baker who stops stoking it from the kneading of dough until it rises.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם מְנָאֲפִים כְּמוֹ תַנּוּר בֹּעֵרָה מֵאֹפֶה יִשְׁבּוֹת מֵעִיר מִלּוּשׁ בָּצֵק עַד־חֻמְצָתוֹ׃

verses.english: On our king's day, officials become sick with wine's heat; he extends his hand with scoffers.
verses.hebrew: יוֹם מַלְכֵּנוּ הֶחֱלוּ שָׂרִים חֲמַת מִיָּיִן מָשַׁךְ יָדוֹ אֶת־לֹצְצִים׃

verses.english: For they bring their heart near like an oven in their ambush; all night their baker sleeps, and in the morning it burns like a flaming fire.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־קֵרְבוּ כַתַּנּוּר לִבָּם בְּאָרְבָּם כָּל־הַלַּיְלָה יָשֵׁן אֹפֵהֶם בֹּקֶר הוּא בֹעֵר כְּאֵשׁ לֶהָבָה׃

verses.english: All of them grow hot like an oven and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen; no one among them calls to Me.
verses.hebrew: כֻּלָּם יֵחַמּוּ כַּתַּנּוּר וְאָכְלוּ אֶת־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם כָּל־מַלְכֵיהֶם נָפָלוּ אֵין־קֹרֵא בָהֶם אֵלָי׃

verses.english: Ephraim mixes himself among the peoples; Ephraim has become a cake not turned.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְרַיִם בָּעַמִּים הוּא יִתְבּוֹלָל אֶפְרַיִם הָיָה עֻגָה בְּלִי הֲפוּכָה׃

verses.english: Foreigners devour his strength, but he does not know it; gray hair is sprinkled upon him, but he does not know it.
verses.hebrew: אָכְלוּ זָרִים כֹּחוֹ וְהוּא לֹא יָדָע גַּם־שֵׂיבָה זָרְקָה בּוֹ וְהוּא לֹא יָדָע׃

verses.english: Israel's pride testifies against him, yet they have not returned to YHWH their God or sought Him in all this.
verses.hebrew: וְעָנָה גְאוֹן־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּפָנָיו וְלֹא־שָׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְלֹא בִקְשֻׁהוּ בְּכָל־זֹאת׃

verses.english: Ephraim has become like a gullible dove without understanding; they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אֶפְרַיִם כְּיוֹנָה פוֹתָה אֵין לֵב מִצְרַיִם קָרָאוּ אַשּׁוּר הָלָכוּ׃

verses.english: As they go, I will spread My net over them; I will bring them down like heaven's birds. I will discipline them according to what their congregation has heard.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר יֵלֵכוּ אֶפְרוֹשׂ עֲלֵיהֶם רִשְׁתִּי כְּעוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם אוֹרִידֵם אַיְסִרֵם כְּשֵׁמַע לַעֲדָתָם׃

verses.english: Woe to them, for they have wandered from Me! Devastation to them, for they have rebelled against Me! I would redeem them, but they speak lies against Me.
verses.hebrew: אוֹי לָהֶם כִּי־נָדְדוּ מִמֶּנִּי שֹׁד לָהֶם כִּי־פָשְׁעוּ בִי וְאָנֹכִי אֶפְדֵּם וְהֵמָּה דִּבְּרוּ עָלַי כְּזָבִים׃

verses.english: They do not cry to Me from their hearts when they howl on their beds. They gather for grain and new wine; they turn away against Me.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־זָעֲקוּ אֵלַי בְּלִבָּם כִּי יְיֵלִילוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָם עַל־דָּגָן וְתִירוֹשׁ יִתְגּוֹרָרוּ יָסוּרוּ בִי׃

verses.english: I disciplined them and strengthened their arms, but they devise evil against Me.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי יִסַּרְתִּי חִזַּקְתִּי זְרוֹעֹתָם וְאֵלַי יְחַשְּׁבוּ־רָע׃

verses.english: They return, but not upward; they are like a treacherous bow. Their officials will fall by the sword because of their tongues' rage. This will be their mockery in Egypt's land.
verses.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ לֹא עָל הָיוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה יִפְּלוּ בַחֶרֶב שָׂרֵיהֶם מִזַּעַם לְשׁוֹנָם זוֹ לַעְגָּם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Put a horn to your mouth! Like an eagle against YHWH's house! For they transgressed My covenant and rebelled against My instruction.
verses.hebrew: אֶל־חִכְּךָ שֹׁפָר כַּנֶּשֶׁר עַל־בֵּית יְהוָה יַעַן עָבְרוּ בְרִיתִי וְעַל־תּוֹרָתִי פָּשָׁעוּ׃

verses.english: They cry to Me, ‘My God, we—Israel—know You!’
verses.hebrew: לִי יִזְעָקוּ אֱלֹהַי יְדַעֲנוּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Israel has rejected what is good; an enemy will pursue him.
verses.hebrew: זָנַח יִשְׂרָאֵל טוֹב אוֹיֵב יִרְדְּפוֹ׃

verses.english: They appointed kings, but not from Me; they appointed officials, but I did not know it. From their silver and gold they made idols for themselves, so that it might be cut off.
verses.hebrew: הֵם הִמְלִיכוּ וְלֹא מִמֶּנִּי הֵשִׂירוּ וְלֹא יָדָעְתִּי כַּסְפָּם וּזְהָבָם עָשׂוּ לָהֶם עֲצַבִּים לְמַעַן יִכָּרֵת׃

verses.english: Your calf is rejected, Samaria! My anger burns against them. How long will they be incapable of innocence?
verses.hebrew: זָנַח עֶגְלֵךְ שֹׁמְרוֹן חָרָה אַפִּי בָּם עַד־מָתַי לֹא יוּכְלוּ נִקָּיֹן׃

verses.english: For it too is from Israel: a craftsman made it, and it is no god. Indeed, Samaria's calf will become splinters.
verses.hebrew: כִּי מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל וְהוּא חָרָשׁ עָשָׂהוּ וְלֹא אֱלֹהִים הוּא כִּי־שְׁבָבִים יִהְיֶה עֵגֶל שֹׁמְרוֹן׃

verses.english: For they sow wind and will reap a whirlwind. The standing grain has no head; it produces no flour. Even if it produces any, foreigners will swallow it.
verses.hebrew: כִּי רוּחַ יִזְרָעוּ וְסוּפָתָה יִקְצֹרוּ קָמָה אֵין־לוֹ צֶמַח בְּלִי יַעֲשֶׂה־קֶּמַח אוּלַי יַעֲשֶׂה זָרִים יִבְלָעֻהוּ׃

verses.english: Israel is swallowed up; now they are among the nations like a vessel no one desires.
verses.hebrew: נִבְלַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עַתָּה הָיוּ בַגּוֹיִם כִּכְלִי אֵין־חֵפֶץ בּוֹ׃

verses.english: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild donkey alone by itself. Ephraim has hired lovers.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הֵמָּה עָלוּ אַשּׁוּר פֶּרֶא בּוֹדֵד לוֹ אֶפְרַיִם הִתְנוּ אֲהָבִים

verses.english: Even though they hire among the nations, now I will gather them; they will begin to suffer a little under the burden of a king of officials.
verses.hebrew: גַּם כִּי־יִתְנוּ בַגּוֹיִם עַתָּה אֲקַבְּצֵם וַיָּחֵלּוּ מְּעָט מִמַּשָּׂא מֶלֶךְ שָׂרִים׃

verses.english: Because Ephraim multiplied altars for sinning, they became altars for him to sin.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִרְבָּה אֶפְרַיִם מִזְבְּחֹת לַחֲטֹא הָיוּ־לוֹ מִזְבְּחוֹת לַחֲטֹא׃

verses.english: I write for him the many things of My instruction, but they are reckoned as something foreign.
verses.hebrew: אכתוב־[אֶכְתָּב־] לוֹ רבו [רֻבֵּי] תּוֹרָתִי כְּמוֹ־זָר נֶחְשָׁבוּ׃

verses.english: As for the sacrifices of My gifts, they sacrifice meat and eat it; YHWH does not accept them. Now He will remember their guilt and call their sins to account; they will return to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: זִבְחֵי הַבְהָבַי יִזְבְּחוּ בָשָׂר וַיֹּאכֵלוּ יְהוָה לֹא רָצָם עַתָּה יִזְכֹּר עֲוֺנָם וְיִפְקֹד חַטֹּאותָם הֵמָּה מִצְרַיִם יָשׁוּבוּ׃

verses.english: Israel forgot his Maker and built palaces; Judah multiplied fortified cities. I will send fire into his cities, and it will devour her strongholds.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁכַּח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־עֹשֵׂהוּ וַיִּבֶן הֵיכָלוֹת וִיהוּדָה הִרְבָּה עָרִים בְּצֻרוֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵשׁ בְּעָרָיו וְאָכְלָה אַרְמְנֹתֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Do not rejoice, Israel, with exultation like the peoples, for you prostituted yourself away from your God; you loved a prostitute's payment on every threshing floor of grain.
verses.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־גִּיל כָּעַמִּים כִּי זָנִיתָ מֵעַל אֱלֹהֶיךָ אָהַבְתָּ אֶתְנָן עַל כָּל־גָּרְנוֹת דָּגָן׃

verses.english: Threshing floor and winepress will not feed them, and new wine will fail her.
verses.hebrew: גֹּרֶן וָיֶקֶב לֹא יִרְעֵם וְתִירוֹשׁ יְכַחֶשׁ בָּהּ׃

verses.english: They will not dwell in YHWH's land; Ephraim will return to Egypt, and in Assyria they will eat unclean food.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יֵשְׁבוּ בְּאֶרֶץ יְהוָה וְשָׁב אֶפְרַיִם מִצְרַיִם וּבְאַשּׁוּר טָמֵא יֹאכֵלוּ׃

verses.english: They will not pour wine to YHWH, and their sacrifices will not please Him. Their sacrifices will be like mourners' bread to them; all who eat it become unclean. Their bread is for their own appetite; it will not enter YHWH's house.
verses.hebrew: לֹא־יִסְּכוּ לַיהוָה יַיִן וְלֹא יֶעֶרְבוּ־לוֹ זִבְחֵיהֶם כְּלֶחֶם אוֹנִים לָהֶם כָּל־אֹכְלָיו יִטַמָּאוּ כִּי־לַחְמָם לְנַפְשָׁם לֹא יָבוֹא בֵּית יְהוָה׃

verses.english: What will you do on the day of the appointed gathering, on the day of YHWH's festival?
verses.hebrew: מַה־תַּעֲשׂוּ לְיוֹם מוֹעֵד וּלְיוֹם חַג־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: For look, they have gone away from devastation. Egypt will gather them; Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their precious silver things; thorns will be in their tents.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה הָלְכוּ מִשֹּׁד מִצְרַיִם תְּקַבְּצֵם מֹף תְּקַבְּרֵם מַחְמַד לְכַסְפָּם קִמּוֹשׂ יִירָשֵׁם חוֹחַ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: The days of reckoning have come; the days of repayment have come. Israel will know it. The prophet is a fool; the man of the spirit is mad, because your guilt is great and hostility is great.
verses.hebrew: בָּאוּ יְמֵי הַפְּקֻדָּה בָּאוּ יְמֵי הַשִׁלֻּם יֵדְעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֱוִיל הַנָּבִיא מְשֻׁגָּע אִישׁ הָרוּחַ עַל רֹב עֲוֺנְךָ וְרַבָּה מַשְׂטֵמָה׃

verses.english: Ephraim's watchman is with my God; as for the prophet, a birdcatcher's trap is on all his ways, hostility in his God's house.
verses.hebrew: צֹפֶה אֶפְרַיִם עִם־אֱלֹהָי נָבִיא פַּח יָקוֹשׁ עַל־כָּל־דְּרָכָיו מַשְׂטֵמָה בְּבֵית אֱלֹהָיו׃

verses.english: They have sunk deep into corruption, as in Gibeah's days. He will remember their guilt; He will call their sins to account.
verses.hebrew: הֶעְמִיקוּ־שִׁחֵתוּ כִּימֵי הַגִּבְעָה יִזְכּוֹר עֲוֺנָם יִפְקוֹד חַטֹּאותָם׃

verses.english: Like grapes in the wilderness I found Israel; like the first fruit on a fig tree in its first season I saw your fathers. They went to Baal-peor, consecrated themselves to shame and became detestable like what they loved.
verses.hebrew: כַּעֲנָבִים בַּמִּדְבָּר מָצָאתִי יִשְׂרָאֵל כְּבִכּוּרָה בִתְאֵנָה בְּרֵאשִׁיתָהּ רָאִיתִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם הֵמָּה בָּאוּ בַעַל־פְּעוֹר וַיִּנָּזְרוּ לַבֹּשֶׁת וַיִּהְיוּ שִׁקּוּצִים כְּאָהֳבָם׃

verses.english: Ephraim—their glory will fly away like a bird, away from birth, from the womb and from conception.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְרַיִם כָּעוֹף יִתְעוֹפֵף כְּבוֹדָם מִלֵּדָה וּמִבֶּטֶן וּמֵהֵרָיוֹן׃

verses.english: Even if they rear their sons, I will bereave them until no person remains. Yes, woe to them when I turn away from them!
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־יְגַדְּלוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְשִׁכַּלְתִּים מֵאָדָם כִּי־גַם־אוֹי לָהֶם בְּשׂוּרִי מֵהֶם׃

verses.english: Ephraim, as I saw him, was like Tyre planted in a pasture; but Ephraim must bring his sons out to a killer.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְרַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־רָאִיתִי לְצוֹר שְׁתוּלָה בְנָוֶה וְאֶפְרַיִם לְהוֹצִיא אֶל־הֹרֵג בָּנָיו׃

verses.english: Give them, YHWH—what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.hebrew: תֵּן־לָהֶם יְהוָה מַה־תִּתֵּן תֵּן־לָהֶם רֶחֶם מַשְׁכִּיל וְשָׁדַיִם צֹמְקִים׃

verses.english: All their evil is at Gilgal; there I hated them. Because of their evil deeds I will drive them from My house. I will love them no longer; all their officials are rebels.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־רָעָתָם בַּגִּלְגָּל כִּי־שָׁם שְׂנֵאתִים עַל רֹעַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶם מִבֵּיתִי אֲגָרְשֵׁם לֹא אוֹסֵף אַהֲבָתָם כָּל־שָׂרֵיהֶם סֹרְרִים׃

verses.english: Ephraim is struck; their root is dry, and they will produce no fruit. Even if they give birth, I will put to death the precious offspring of their womb.
verses.hebrew: הֻכָּה אֶפְרַיִם שָׁרְשָׁם יָבֵשׁ פְּרִי בלי־[בַל־] יַעֲשׂוּן גַּם כִּי יֵלֵדוּן וְהֵמַתִּי מַחֲמַדֵּי בִטְנָם׃

verses.english: My God will reject them because they have not listened to Him, and they will be wanderers among the nations.
verses.hebrew: יִמְאָסֵם אֱלֹהַי כִּי לֹא שָׁמְעוּ לוֹ וְיִהְיוּ נֹדְדִים בַּגּוֹיִם׃

verses.english: Israel is a spreading vine, producing fruit for itself. As its fruit increased, it multiplied altars; as its land prospered, they made splendid standing stones.
verses.hebrew: גֶּפֶן בּוֹקֵק יִשְׂרָאֵל פְּרִי יְשַׁוֶּה־לּוֹ כְּרֹב לְפִרְיוֹ הִרְבָּה לַמִּזְבְּחוֹת כְּטוֹב לְאַרְצוֹ הֵיטִיבוּ מַצֵּבוֹת׃

verses.english: Their heart is divided; now they will bear guilt. He will break down their altars and devastate their standing stones.
verses.hebrew: חָלַק לִבָּם עַתָּה יֶאְשָׁמוּ הוּא יַעֲרֹף מִזְבְּחוֹתָם יְשֹׁדֵד מַצֵּבוֹתָם׃

verses.english: For now they will say, ‘We have no king, because we did not fear YHWH; and a king—what could he do for us?’
verses.hebrew: כִּי עַתָּה יֹאמְרוּ אֵין מֶלֶךְ לָנוּ כִּי לֹא יָרֵאנוּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה וְהַמֶּלֶךְ מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה־לָּנוּ׃

verses.english: They speak words, swear empty oaths and make a covenant; judgment sprouts like poisonous weed in the field's furrows.
verses.hebrew: דִּבְּרוּ דְבָרִים אָלוֹת שָׁוְא כָּרֹת בְּרִית וּפָרַח כָּרֹאשׁ מִשְׁפָּט עַל תַּלְמֵי שָׂדָי׃

verses.english: Samaria's inhabitants tremble for Beth-aven's calves. Its people mourn over it, and its idol-priests exult over it, over its glory, because it has departed from it.
verses.hebrew: לְעֶגְלוֹת בֵּית אָוֶן יָגוּרוּ שְׁכַן שֹׁמְרוֹן כִּי־אָבַל עָלָיו עַמּוֹ וּכְמָרָיו עָלָיו יָגִילוּ עַל־כְּבוֹדוֹ כִּי־גָלָה מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: It too will be carried to Assyria as a gift to King Jareb. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his counsel.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אוֹתוֹ לְאַשּׁוּר יוּבָל מִנְחָה לְמֶלֶךְ יָרֵב בָּשְׁנָה אֶפְרַיִם יִקָּח וְיֵבוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵעֲצָתוֹ׃

verses.english: Samaria's king is destroyed, like foam on the water's surface.
verses.hebrew: נִדְמֶה שֹׁמְרוֹן מַלְכָּהּ כְּקֶצֶף עַל־פְּנֵי־מָיִם׃

verses.english: The high places of Aven, Israel's sin, will be destroyed; thorn and thistle will grow on their altars. They will say to the mountains, ‘Cover us!’ and to the hills, ‘Fall on us!’
verses.hebrew: וְנִשְׁמְדוּ בָּמוֹת אָוֶן חַטַּאת יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹץ וְדַרְדַּר יַעֲלֶה עַל־מִזְבְּחוֹתָם וְאָמְרוּ לֶהָרִים כַּסּוּנוּ וְלַגְּבָעוֹת נִפְלוּ עָלֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Since Gibeah's days you have sinned, Israel; there they stood. Will war against the sons of injustice not overtake them in Gibeah?
verses.hebrew: מִימֵי הַגִּבְעָה חָטָאתָ יִשְׂרָאֵל שָׁם עָמָדוּ לֹא־תַשִּׂיגֵם בַּגִּבְעָה מִלְחָמָה עַל־בְּנֵי עַלְוָה׃

verses.english: At My desire I will discipline them; peoples will gather against them when they are bound for their two offenses.
verses.hebrew: בְּאַוָּתִי וְאֶסֳּרֵם וְאֻסְּפוּ עֲלֵיהֶם עַמִּים בְּאָסְרָם לִשְׁתֵּי עינתם [עוֹנֹתָם׃]

verses.english: Ephraim is a trained heifer loving to thresh, and I passed over her fine neck. I will harness Ephraim; Judah will plow, and Jacob will harrow for him.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶפְרַיִם עֶגְלָה מְלֻמָּדָה אֹהַבְתִּי לָדוּשׁ וַאֲנִי עָבַרְתִּי עַל־טוּב צַוָּארָהּ אַרְכִּיב אֶפְרַיִם יַחֲרוֹשׁ יְהוּדָה יְשַׂדֶּד־לוֹ יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: Sow for yourselves in righteousness; reap according to steadfast love. Break up your fallow ground, for it is time to seek YHWH until He comes and rains righteousness upon you.
verses.hebrew: זִרְעוּ לָכֶם לִצְדָקָה קִצְרוּ לְפִי־חֶסֶד נִירוּ לָכֶם נִיר וְעֵת לִדְרוֹשׁ אֶת־יְהוָה עַד־יָבוֹא וְיֹרֶה צֶדֶק לָכֶם׃

verses.english: You plowed wickedness and reaped injustice; you ate falsehood's fruit. For you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your warriors.
verses.hebrew: חֲרַשְׁתֶּם־רֶשַׁע עַוְלָתָה קְצַרְתֶּם אֲכַלְתֶּם פְּרִי־כָחַשׁ כִּי־בָטַחְתָּ בְדַרְכְּךָ בְּרֹב גִּבּוֹרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: An uproar will rise among your people, and all your fortresses will be devastated, as Shalman devastated Beth-arbel on a day of battle, when a mother was dashed to pieces upon her children.
verses.hebrew: וְקָאם שָׁאוֹן בְּעַמֶּךָ וְכָל־מִבְצָרֶיךָ יוּשַּׁד כְּשֹׁד שַׁלְמַן בֵּית אַרְבֵאל בְּיוֹם מִלְחָמָה אֵם עַל־בָּנִים רֻטָּשָׁה׃

verses.english: So Bethel has done to you because of your utter wickedness. At dawn Israel's king will surely be destroyed.
verses.hebrew: כָּכָה עָשָׂה לָכֶם בֵּית־אֵל מִפְּנֵי רָעַת רָעַתְכֶם בַּשַּׁחַר נִדְמֹה נִדְמָה מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: When Israel was a boy, I loved him, and out of Egypt I called My son.
verses.hebrew: כִּי נַעַר יִשְׂרָאֵל וָאֹהֲבֵהוּ וּמִמִּצְרַיִם קָרָאתִי לִבְנִי׃

verses.english: The more they called them, the more they went away from them; they sacrificed to the Baals and burned offerings to carved images.
verses.hebrew: קָרְאוּ לָהֶם כֵּן הָלְכוּ מִפְּנֵיהֶם לַבְּעָלִים יְזַבֵּחוּ וְלַפְּסִלִים יְקַטֵּרוּן׃

verses.english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk, taking them upon his arms, but they did not know that I healed them.
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי תִרְגַּלְתִּי לְאֶפְרַיִם קָחָם עַל־זְרוֹעֹתָיו וְלֹא יָדְעוּ כִּי רְפָאתִים׃

verses.english: With human cords I drew them, with bands of love. I was to them like those lifting a yoke over their jaws, and I bent toward him to feed him.
verses.hebrew: בְּחַבְלֵי אָדָם אֶמְשְׁכֵם בַּעֲבֹתוֹת אַהֲבָה וָאֶהְיֶה לָהֶם כִּמְרִימֵי עֹל עַל לְחֵיהֶם וְאַט אֵלָיו אוֹכִיל׃

verses.english: He will not return to Egypt's land, but Assyria will be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.hebrew: לֹא יָשׁוּב אֶל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וְאַשּׁוּר הוּא מַלְכּוֹ כִּי מֵאֲנוּ לָשׁוּב׃

verses.english: A sword will whirl through his cities, consume his bars and devour because of their plans.
verses.hebrew: וְחָלָה חֶרֶב בְּעָרָיו וְכִלְּתָה בַדָּיו וְאָכָלָה מִמֹּעֲצוֹתֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: My people cling to turning away from Me. Though they call him upward, together no one raises him.
verses.hebrew: וְעַמִּי תְלוּאִים לִמְשׁוּבָתִי וְאֶל־עַל יִקְרָאֻהוּ יַחַד לֹא יְרוֹמֵם׃

verses.english: How can I give you up, Ephraim, surrender you, Israel? How can I make you like Admah, set you like Zeboiim? My heart turns within Me; all My compassion grows warm.
verses.hebrew: אֵיךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ אֶפְרַיִם אֲמַגֶּנְךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֵיךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ כְאַדְמָה אֲשִׂימְךָ כִּצְבֹאיִם נֶהְפַּךְ עָלַי לִבִּי יַחַד נִכְמְרוּ נִחוּמָי׃

verses.english: I will not carry out My burning anger; I will not again destroy Ephraim. For I am God and not a man, the Holy One in your midst, and I will not enter a city.
verses.hebrew: לֹא אֶעֱשֶׂה חֲרוֹן אַפִּי לֹא אָשׁוּב לְשַׁחֵת אֶפְרָיִם כִּי אֵל אָנֹכִי וְלֹא־אִישׁ בְּקִרְבְּךָ קָדוֹשׁ וְלֹא אָבוֹא בְּעִיר׃

verses.english: They will walk after YHWH; He will roar like a lion. When He roars, sons will come trembling from the sea.
verses.hebrew: אַחֲרֵי יְהוָה יֵלְכוּ כְּאַרְיֵה יִשְׁאָג כִּי־הוּא יִשְׁאַג וְיֶחֶרְדוּ בָנִים מִיָּם׃

verses.english: They will come trembling like a bird from Egypt, like a dove from Assyria's land, and I will settle them in their houses, declares YHWH.
verses.hebrew: יֶחֶרְדוּ כְצִפּוֹר מִמִּצְרַיִם וּכְיוֹנָה מֵאֶרֶץ אַשּׁוּר וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּים עַל־בָּתֵּיהֶם נְאֻם־יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Ephraim has surrounded Me with falsehood, and Israel's house with deceit. Judah still rules with God and is faithful with the holy ones.
verses.hebrew: סְבָבֻנִי בְכַחַשׁ אֶפְרַיִם וּבְמִרְמָה בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וִיהוּדָה עֹד רָד עִם־אֵל וְעִם־קְדוֹשִׁים נֶאֱמָן׃

verses.english: Ephraim feeds on wind and pursues the east wind all day; he multiplies falsehood and devastation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְרַיִם רֹעֶה רוּחַ וְרֹדֵף קָדִים כָּל־הַיּוֹם כָּזָב וָשֹׁד יַרְבֶּה וּבְרִית עִם־אַשּׁוּר יִכְרֹתוּ וְשֶׁמֶן לְמִצְרַיִם יוּבָל׃

verses.english: YHWH has a dispute with Judah and will call Jacob to account according to his ways; He will repay him according to his deeds.
verses.hebrew: וְרִיב לַיהוָה עִם־יְהוּדָה וְלִפְקֹד עַל־יַעֲקֹב כִּדְרָכָיו כְּמַעֲלָלָיו יָשִׁיב לוֹ׃

verses.english: In the womb he grasped his brother's heel, and in his strength he strove with God.
verses.hebrew: בַּבֶּטֶן עָקַב אֶת־אָחִיו וּבְאוֹנוֹ שָׂרָה אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃

verses.english: He strove with a messenger and prevailed; he wept and begged his favor. At Bethel He finds him, and there He speaks with us.
verses.hebrew: וָיָּשַׂר אֶל־מַלְאָךְ וַיֻּכָל בָּכָה וַיִּתְחַנֶּן־לוֹ בֵּית־אֵל יִמְצָאֶנּוּ וְשָׁם יְדַבֵּר עִמָּנוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH is the God of hosts; YHWH is His memorial name.
verses.hebrew: וַיהוָה אֱלֹהֵי הַצְּבָאוֹת יְהוָה זִכְרוֹ׃

verses.english: But you, return with your God's help; keep steadfast love and justice, and wait continually for your God.
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה בֵּאלֹהֶיךָ תָשׁוּב חֶסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט שְׁמֹר וְקַוֵּה אֶל־אֱלֹהֶיךָ תָּמִיד׃

verses.english: A Canaanite trader—in his hand are deceitful scales; he loves to oppress.
verses.hebrew: כְּנַעַן בְּיָדוֹ מֹאזְנֵי מִרְמָה לַעֲשֹׁק אָהֵב׃

verses.english: Ephraim says, ‘Surely I have become rich; I have found wealth for myself. In all my toil they will find no guilt in me that is sin.’
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶפְרַיִם אַךְ עָשַׁרְתִּי מָצָאתִי אוֹן לִי כָּל־יְגִיעַי לֹא יִמְצְאוּ־לִי עָוֺן אֲשֶׁר־חֵטְא׃

verses.english: But I am YHWH your God from Egypt's land; I will make you dwell in tents again, as in the days of the appointed gathering.
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם עֹד אוֹשִׁיבְךָ בָאֳהָלִים כִּימֵי מוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: I spoke to the prophets; I multiplied vision and gave comparisons through the prophets.
verses.hebrew: וְדִבַּרְתִּי עַל־הַנְּבִיאִים וְאָנֹכִי חָזוֹן הִרְבֵּיתִי וּבְיַד הַנְּבִיאִים אֲדַמֶּה׃

verses.english: If Gilead is wickedness, surely they have become emptiness. At Gilgal they sacrificed bulls; their altars too are like heaps upon the field's furrows.
verses.hebrew: אִם־גִּלְעָד אָוֶן אַךְ־שָׁוְא הָיוּ בַּגִּלְגָּל שְׁוָרִים זִבֵּחוּ גַּם מִזְבְּחוֹתָם כְּגַלִּים עַל תַּלְמֵי שָׂדָי׃

verses.english: Jacob fled to Aram's country; Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept watch.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבְרַח יַעֲקֹב שְׂדֵה אֲרָם וַיַּעֲבֹד יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּאִשָּׁה וּבְאִשָּׁה שָׁמָר׃

verses.english: Through a prophet YHWH brought Israel up from Egypt, and through a prophet he was kept safe.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנָבִיא הֶעֱלָה יְהוָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם וּבְנָבִיא נִשְׁמָר׃

verses.english: Ephraim has provoked bitter anger. His Lord will leave his bloodguilt upon him and repay him for his reproach.
verses.hebrew: הִכְעִיס אֶפְרַיִם תַּמְרוּרִים וְדָמָיו עָלָיו יִטּוֹשׁ וְחֶרְפָּתוֹ יָשִׁיב לוֹ אֲדֹנָיו׃

verses.english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel. But he incurred guilt through Baal and died.
verses.hebrew: כְּדַבֵּר אֶפְרַיִם רְתֵת נָשָׂא הוּא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֶּאְשַׁם בַּבַּעַל וַיָּמֹת׃

verses.english: Now they keep on sinning; they make themselves a cast image from their silver, idols according to their understanding, all of it craftsmen's work. Of them they say, ‘Those sacrificing humans kiss calves!’
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יוֹסִפוּ לַחֲטֹא וַיַּעְשׂוּ לָהֶם מַסֵּכָה מִכַּסְפָּם כִּתְבוּנָם עֲצַבִּים מַעֲשֵׂה חָרָשִׁים כֻּלֹּה לָהֶם הֵם אֹמְרִים זֹבְחֵי אָדָם עֲגָלִים יִשָּׁקוּן׃

verses.english: Therefore they will be like a morning cloud, like dew that goes away early, like chaff storm-driven from a threshing floor and like smoke from a window.
verses.hebrew: לָכֵן יִהְיוּ כַּעֲנַן־בֹּקֶר וְכַטַּל מַשְׁכִּים הֹלֵךְ כְּמֹץ יְסֹעֵר מִגֹּרֶן וּכְעָשָׁן מֵאֲרֻבָּה׃

verses.english: But I am YHWH your God from Egypt's land; you shall know no god besides Me, and there is no savior apart from Me.
verses.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וֵאלֹהִים זוּלָתִי לֹא תֵדָע וּמוֹשִׁיעַ אַיִן בִּלְתִּי׃

verses.english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of scorching drought.
verses.hebrew: אֲנִי יְדַעְתִּיךָ בַּמִּדְבָּר בְּאֶרֶץ תַּלְאֻבוֹת׃

verses.english: According to their pasture they became satisfied; they were satisfied, and their heart rose high. Therefore they forgot Me.
verses.hebrew: כְּמַרְעִיתָם וַיִּשְׂבָּעוּ שָׂבְעוּ וַיָּרָם לִבָּם עַל־כֵּן שְׁכֵחוּנִי׃

verses.english: So I became like a lion to them; like a leopard I will watch along the road.
verses.hebrew: וָאֱהִי לָהֶם כְּמוֹ־שָׁחַל כְּנָמֵר עַל־דֶּרֶךְ אָשׁוּר׃

verses.english: I will meet them like a bear bereaved of cubs and tear open the enclosure of their heart. There I will devour them like a lion; a field beast will rip them apart.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְגְּשֵׁם כְּדֹב שַׁכּוּל וְאֶקְרַע סְגוֹר לִבָּם וְאֹכְלֵם שָׁם כְּלָבִיא חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה תְּבַקְּעֵם׃

verses.english: It is your destruction, Israel, that you are against Me, against your help.
verses.hebrew: שִׁחֶתְךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־בִי בְעֶזְרֶךָ׃

verses.english: Where then is your king, that he may save you in all your cities? Where are your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and officials’?
verses.hebrew: אֱהִי מַלְכְּךָ אֵפוֹא וְיוֹשִׁיעֲךָ בְּכָל־עָרֶיךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ תְּנָה־לִּי מֶלֶךְ וְשָׂרִים׃

verses.english: I give you a king in My anger and take him away in My fury.
verses.hebrew: אֶתֶּן־לְךָ מֶלֶךְ בְּאַפִּי וְאֶקַּח בְּעֶבְרָתִי׃

verses.english: Ephraim's guilt is bound up; his sin is stored away.
verses.hebrew: צָרוּר עֲוֺן אֶפְרָיִם צְפוּנָה חַטָּאתוֹ׃

verses.english: A woman's birth pangs will come upon him. He is an unwise son, for at the proper time he does not take his place at the opening where children are born.
verses.hebrew: חֶבְלֵי יוֹלֵדָה יָבֹאוּ לוֹ הוּא־בֵן לֹא חָכָם כִּי־עֵת לֹא־יַעֲמֹד בְּמִשְׁבַּר בָּנִים׃

verses.english: Shall I ransom them from Sheol's power? Shall I redeem them from death? Where are your plagues, Death? Where is your destruction, Sheol? Compassion is hidden from My eyes.
verses.hebrew: מִיַּד שְׁאוֹל אֶפְדֵּם מִמָּוֶת אֶגְאָלֵם אֱהִי דְבָרֶיךָ מָוֶת אֱהִי קָטָבְךָ שְׁאוֹל נֹחַם יִסָּתֵר מֵעֵינָי׃

verses.english: Though he bears fruit among brothers, an east wind will come, YHWH's wind rising from the wilderness. His spring will dry up and his fountain become parched; it will plunder the treasury of every precious vessel.
verses.hebrew: כִּי הוּא בֵּן אַחִים יַפְרִיא יָבוֹא קָדִים רוּחַ יְהוָה מִמִּדְבָּר עֹלֶה וְיֵבוֹשׁ מְקוֹרוֹ וְיֶחֱרַב מַעְיָנוֹ הוּא יִשְׁסֶה אוֹצַר כָּל־כְּלִי חֶמְדָּה׃

verses.english: Samaria will bear guilt because she rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword; their little children will be dashed to pieces, and his pregnant women will be ripped open.
verses.hebrew: תֶּאְשַׁם שֹׁמְרוֹן כִּי מָרְתָה בֵּאלֹהֶיהָ בַּחֶרֶב יִפֹּלוּ עֹלְלֵיהֶם יְרֻטָּשׁוּ וְהָרִיּוֹתָיו יְבֻקָּעוּ׃

verses.english: Return, Israel, to YHWH your God, for you have stumbled through your guilt.
verses.hebrew: שׁוּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵל עַד יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ כִּי כָשַׁלְתָּ בַּעֲוֺנֶךָ׃

verses.english: Take words with you and return to YHWH. Say to Him, ‘Take away all guilt and accept what is good; we will repay bulls through our lips.
verses.hebrew: קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם דְּבָרִים וְשׁוּבוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אִמְרוּ אֵלָיו כָּל־תִּשָּׂא עָוֺן וְקַח־טוֹב וּנְשַׁלְּמָה פָרִים שְׂפָתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Assyria will not save us; we will not ride on horses, and we will no longer call the work of our hands “Our God,” for in You the orphan finds compassion.’
verses.hebrew: אַשּׁוּר לֹא יוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ עַל־סוּס לֹא נִרְכָּב וְלֹא־נֹאמַר עוֹד אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר־בְּךָ יְרֻחַם יָתוֹם׃

verses.english: I will heal their turning away; I will love them freely, for My anger has turned away from him.
verses.hebrew: אֶרְפָּא מְשׁוּבָתָם אֹהֲבֵם נְדָבָה כִּי שָׁב אַפִּי מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: I will be like dew to Israel; he will blossom like a lily and strike his roots like Lebanon.
verses.hebrew: אֶהְיֶה כַטַּל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל יִפְרַח כַּשּׁוֹשַׁנָּה וְיַךְ שָׁרָשָׁיו כַּלְּבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: His shoots will spread; his splendor will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.
verses.hebrew: יֵלְכוּ יֹנְקוֹתָיו וִיהִי כַזַּיִת הוֹדוֹ וְרֵיחַ לוֹ כַּלְּבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: Those dwelling in his shade will return; they will revive grain and blossom like the vine. His renown will be like Lebanon's wine.
verses.hebrew: יָשֻׁבוּ יֹשְׁבֵי בְצִלּוֹ יְחַיּוּ דָגָן וְיִפְרְחוּ כַגָּפֶן זִכְרוֹ כְּיֵין לְבָנוֹן׃

verses.english: Ephraim, what have I still to do with idols? I have answered, and I will watch over him. I am like a luxuriant cypress; from Me your fruit is found.
verses.hebrew: אֶפְרַיִם מַה־לִּי עוֹד לָעֲצַבִּים אֲנִי עָנִיתִי וַאֲשׁוּרֶנּוּ אֲנִי כִּבְרוֹשׁ רַעֲנָן מִמֶּנִּי פֶּרְיְךָ נִמְצָא׃

verses.english: Who is wise and will understand these things, discerning and will know them? For YHWH's ways are straight; the righteous walk in them, but rebels stumble in them.
verses.hebrew: מִי חָכָם וְיָבֵן אֵלֶּה נָבוֹן וְיֵדָעֵם כִּי־יְשָׁרִים דַּרְכֵי יְהוָה וְצַדִּקִים יֵלְכוּ בָם וּפֹשְׁעִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ בָם׃
